puzzle.hint: The supreme sovereign authority over all of existence — a heavenly kingdom
puzzle.arabicVerse: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
puzzle.verse: 23:88 - Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
